title: Demo Growth Fund — Q2 2026 Supply-Chain Risk Pack

sections.heading: Executive summary
sections.body: The Demo Growth Fund carries a concentrated, correlated dependence on advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Four holdings (NVIDIA, AMD, Apple, Broadcom) — 27.5% of assets — critically depend on TSMC, which in turn sole-sources EUV lithography from ASML. A single foundry or EUV shock would propagate across all four positions simultaneously.

sections.heading: Concentration & HHI
sections.body: Holdings-level HHI is 413 (moderately concentrated); top position NVIDIA at 11.5%. See the Risk dashboard for the per-issuer breakdown and the 'explain this number' Cypher.

sections.heading: Second-order chokepoint
sections.body: TSMC → ASML is a critical, sole-source dependency. The fund's effective exposure to an ASML/EUV disruption is therefore ~30% once the transitive path is included.

sections.heading: Disclosure coverage note
sections.body: The 485BPOS prospectus does NOT currently include a principal-risk section covering foundry / supply concentration, despite the holdings' documented exposure. Recommend adding coverage.

provenance.span: We depend on a limited number of foundries, principally Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), for the fabrication of our GPUs
Our leading-edge manufacturing depends on extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography systems supplied by ASML.

title: Demo Focused Growth Fund — Q2 2026 Concentration Brief

sections.heading: Executive summary
sections.body: The Demo Focused Growth Fund is a high-conviction, concentrated portfolio (HHI 713; top position 16.0%). Its four TSMC-dependent holdings total 37.5% of assets — the single largest correlated exposure in the book.

sections.heading: Concentration & HHI
sections.body: HHI 713 is ~2.6× the diversified sibling fund. Top-4 issuers (NVIDIA, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon) are 45.5% of assets.

sections.heading: Governance note
sections.body: A board interlock (Ada Interlock, director of both NVIDIA and Microsoft) spans 28.0% of the fund's assets — relevant to independence review.
